$schema.description: JSON Schema used to validate this configuration file.

version.description: Configuration schema version. Currently only 1 is supported.

sensitivity.description: Overall detection sensitivity. 'strict' = more warnings, 'relaxed' = fewer warnings.

minimumConfidenceToWarn.description: Minimum confidence score (0.0–1.0) required to show a warning.

debounceMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after typing stops before running detection.

weights.description: Weight of each detection layer in the confidence score calculation. Should sum to 1.0.

thresholds.description: Confidence score thresholds for each severity level.

blockCommitOnCritical.description: Block git commits when critical secrets are detected.

blockCommitOnHigh.description: Block git commits when high-severity secrets are detected.

blockCommitOnMedium.description: Block git commits when medium-severity secrets are detected.

enablePreCommitHook.description: Whether to enable the Git pre-commit hook.

hookInstallPath.description: Path to install the pre-commit hook.

enableSounds.description: Play a sound when secrets are detected or commits are blocked.

showStatusBar.description: Show Keymontr status in the VS Code status bar.

showFileDecorations.description: Show risk badges on files in the Explorer sidebar.

inlineSeverityIcons.description: Show severity emoji icons in diagnostic messages.

showConfidenceScore.description: Show the confidence percentage in diagnostic messages.

ignore.description: Paths and patterns to ignore during scanning

paths.description: Glob patterns for files/directories to exclude from scanning.

patterns.description: Regular expression patterns — strings matching any pattern are ignored.

stopwords.description: Strings containing any stopword are treated as placeholders.

useDefaultIgnorePaths.description: Include Keymontr's built-in ignore paths (node_modules, dist, lock files, etc.).

useDefaultStopwords.description: Include Keymontr's built-in stopwords (example, dummy, placeholder, etc.).

customRules.description: Custom secret detection rules specific to your organization.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this rule detects.

regex.description: Regular expression pattern to match the secret.

entropy.description: Minimum Shannon entropy threshold for matches.

keywords.description: Pre-filter keywords that must appear on the line before regex is tested.

severity.description: Fixed severity level for this rule (overrides confidence scoring).

autoCreateEnvFile.description: Automatically create .env if it does not exist during auto-fix.

autoUpdateGitignore.description: Automatically add .env patterns to .gitignore during auto-fix.

autoCreateEnvExample.description: Automatically add placeholder entries to .env.example during auto-fix.

preferredEnvFileName.description: Name of the environment file to use (e.g. '.env', '.env.local').
